locator.title: Топ-6 аттракционов в «Острове Мечты» для фаната экстрима
locator.caption: Шоу оплачивается отдельно, но поверьте, это того стоит.

current_heading.text: Если горок оказалось недостаточно или хочется пощекотать свои нервы, загляните на иммерсивное шоу «По ту сторону цирка».

nearest_text_before.text: Вас ждет ужасно веселое путешествие по 19 зловещим помещениям старого цирка в компании 20 артистов труппы.

nearest_text_after.text: Одно из главных преимуществ «Острова Мечты»: покупая один билет, вы получаете доступ ко всем 65 аттракционам и 5 шоу, причем безлимитно и на целый день. Развлечения уличной части парка развлечений также входят в единый билет.

image_reading: A giant painted clown head forms the entrance to a circus-themed attraction, framed by red-and-cream striped tents and illuminated signs.
The fixed frontal composition makes the clown face and its open-mouth doorway the focal point; practical marquee bulbs and hanging fabric are visible motion sources.
analysis.article_context: Body image for the separately ticketed immersive horror show «По ту сторону цирка», following its description as a journey through a sinister old circus; the animation should make the ominous circus entrance feel inviting yet unsettling.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The entrance hints at the separately ticketed horror-circus experience and its playful but sinister promise.
structured_intent.primary_action: The existing marquee lights progressively illuminate the circus entrance.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The visible marquee lighting across the circus facade is fully glowing while the central doorway remains dark.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The clown entrance remains an ominous, recognizable threshold into a sinister circus throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the practical bulbs around the entrance and ticket signs awaken in a measured, slightly irregular sequence that travels across the facade, making the clown’s face increasingly imposing. Keep the frontal camera fixed so the doorway and sign remain readable. The spread resolves near the end with all visible marquee lighting steadily glowing; no new event follows.
models.positive_prompt: The marquee bulbs around the circus entrance ignite in a slow uneven sequence, spreading a warm, ominous glow across the clown face and striped tents. Fixed camera. By the final frame the whole entrance is steadily illuminated while the clown remains menacing.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, begin the illumination immediately at one side of the entrance and let it advance smoothly across the striped tents and signs. The stationary frontal view concentrates attention on the clown doorway. The same continuous lighting wave reaches a fully illuminated facade close to the final second and settles there.
models.positive_prompt: A slow wave of marquee lights travels across the circus facade, gradually bathing the clown entrance in a warm eerie glow. Fixed frontal camera; the final frame holds the fully lit, threatening entrance.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds, use a compact continuous sweep of the existing bulbs from the outer tent trim toward the central clown entrance. Keep the camera fixed and preserve the dark open doorway as the focal contrast. The sweep completes just before the end, leaving the facade visibly lit and the circus mood threatening.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed frontal view as the existing marquee bulbs flare on in a quick, uneven sweep around the clown entrance, ending with the entire circus facade glowing ominously and the doorway still dark.
